notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starts 4': Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) ('hoth generator st'), Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker) ('4 marker st'), The Signal ('signal st') and 'ESB'; they count toward the total.

Posted 'ESB' dested Echo Base Operations: no card is called ESB, the deck is titled 'Ebo real twist' and the strategy uses 'the ebo text to grab hoth and another site', so ESB is read as a slip for EBO. It is the starting Effect.

Posted 'first strike I forgot the light side version' is kept as written (UNKNOWN): the author names no Light card. The strategy says Frozen Assets plus 'first strike' is used when the opponent puts a ship in space.

Posted 'solo' dested the Premiere Han Solo (General Solo is listed separately; the wiki's plain 'Solo' card is a modern virtual card). 'obi one' dested the Premiere Obi-Wan Kenobi; 'figuring dan' Figrin D'an; 'daugher sky' Daughter Of Skywalker; 'son sky' Son Of Skywalker.

Posted 'x-wing canon 2' dested X-wing Laser Cannon x2; 'anakins stick 2' Anakin's Lightsaber x2; 'yarma' Yarna d'al' Gargan; 'jedi test 1' Great Warrior (Jedi Test #1); 'projection' Projection Of A Skywalker; 'kessel runs' Kessel Run (an Effect, posted under interrupts); 'frozen assets' Frozen Assets (an Effect, posted under interrupts); 'alter/combo' the Light Alter & Friendly Fire; 'sense/combo' the Light Sense & Recoil In Fear; 'Rende. point' Rendezvous Point; 'dabogah', 'hoth' the Light system printings; 'wise advise' Wise Advice (an Effect in 2001).
The list totals 61 as published: the 'locations 6' header lists seven locations (the section headers add up to 60). Kept as published.
The strategy update says the author 'won the tournament with it today' (no event named). It also says to remove one Organized Attack for the Houjix combo; the list keeps Organized Attack x2.
